reason: Killing Haliya, the opponent's life-gain and card-draw engine, beats spending Deceit's evoke on one discard while Haliya stays on the board.
With no board, a 5/4 lifegain flier is a big threat; the opponent has only a Treasure, so they can't pay 3 for No More Lies.
The opponent's creatures are tapped and they are at 5, so six Monks are lethal either way; Consult's prowess pump only adds margin and digs a card.
The opponent has an empty hand and board, so Jace lands safely and starts drawing cards and making tokens; doing nothing wastes the turn.
On the play, both colours and cheap interaction (two Requiting Hex vs a deck of 1-2 drop Dwarves) make this two-lander a reasonable keep.
Using both mana for Biotech Specialist (a 1/3 blocker vs 2/2s, plus a Lander) beats playing a 1-mana Freebooter.
Holding Spell Snare and Charm at instant speed is better than a sorcery-speed bounce of Dáin's Company that gives back its ETB.
Cryomancer before combat can tap and stun the reach Treefolk and the Harmonizers so Emeritus attacks; after combat that value is lost.
Flashing Drowner in on the opponent's turn keeps Vinelasher stunned through more of their turns and leaves options open; on my turn the stun is partly wasted.
Keeping Verge, Lair and Swamp gives better coloured mana for Kaito and Beavers than keeping the colourless Soulstone Sanctuary.
